messages.content: unable to build nests or care for their young

message.content:
The best match for **“unable to build nests or care for their young”** is **brood parasite**. Brood parasites lay their eggs in other birds’ nests instead of building and raising their own young, so they do not provide normal nest care themselves.[2]

If you want, I can also help identify a specific bird or explain the difference between **brood parasitism** and **nest failure**.
